correctness.rationale: Exact monomial Gram entries and nonzero constant exclusion establish the tridiagonal recurrence. The matrix is strictly row diagonally dominant with excess at least 1; its l_infty inverse norm is at most 1. The small characteristic root and explicit quadratic first-order corrector cancel all terms through n^-1. The residual is a uniformly rho^k-damped polynomial of order n^-2, including both ends of the finite system. Summation yields uniform exterior O(n^-2) and a nonzero 1/n term. Exact rational n=2..12 full Gram checks and independent large-n tridiagonal test passed. The finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The critical n^-2 Sobolev scaling is the balanced threshold where derivative and mass terms have comparable leading energy. For two natural distinct positive probability measures, this exact structural example shows surviving dependence on lambda, identifies the effective mixture, and supplies a genuinely sharp first-order exterior expansion and uniform coefficient error. It resolves a substantive boundary of a recent proposed two-measure asymptotic rather than an arbitrary coefficient computation.
